main.summary: Canonical signed payload for a `DataItem` field assertion.
main.remarks:
This payload binds a specific `DataItem` field representation, hash, issuer identity, and optional descriptive metadata into a canonical structure suitable for signing and detached verification.
Only the current active field state is intended to be represented by an assertion payload. Stale assertions should be replaced rather than accumulated as history in the core `DataItem` model.
The canonical binary layout is owned by `DataFieldAssertionFactory` and is stable by field order rather than by JSON property order.

property.name: AssertionId
property.summary: Unique identifier for the assertion payload.

property.name: DataItemId
property.summary: Identifier of the `DataItem` whose field is covered by the assertion.

property.name: FieldState
property.summary: Representation state covered by the assertion.

property.name: HashAlgorithm
property.summary: Hash algorithm used to produce the asserted hash value.

property.name: Hash
property.summary: Hash bytes for the asserted field representation.

property.name: IssuerObjectId
property.summary: Object identifier of the signer issuing the assertion.

property.name: SubjectObjectId
property.summary: Optional subject object identifier carried by the assertion.

property.name: CreatedAt
property.summary: Creation instant of the assertion payload.

property.name: NotBefore
property.summary: Optional earliest validity instant for the assertion.

property.name: ExpiresAt
property.summary: Optional expiration instant for the assertion.

property.name: Purpose
property.summary: Optional descriptive purpose metadata carried with the assertion.

property.name: Thumbprint
property.summary: Thumbprint of the certificate expected to verify the signed assertion.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create a canonical assertion payload value.
method.param: Representation state covered by the assertion.
Hash algorithm used for the asserted hash value.
Hash bytes for the asserted field representation.

method.returns: A new canonical assertion payload value.
